title: Tohum

characters.GIRL: a young woman with long curly black hair, wearing an orange cardigan

scenes.text: Tohum toprağa düştüğünde kimse onu görmez.
scenes.prompt: {GIRL} kneels in a garden and gently places a single seed into dark soil with her fingers, soft morning light.
A cross-section view of dark earth with a tiny seed alone underground, quiet and patient, roots barely starting, soft glow.
{GIRL} looks at an empty flower pot on a windowsill with a disappointed face, rain on the window.

scenes.text: Ama bir sabah, toprağı yarıp çıkar.
scenes.prompt: A tiny green sprout breaks through the soil in a flower pot on a sunny windowsill, glowing morning sunlight, {GIRL} gasps with joy in the background.

scenes.text: Sen de karanlıktaysan, belki sadece büyüyorsun.
scenes.prompt: {GIRL} stands in a blooming garden full of flowers at golden hour, smiling with eyes closed, arms slightly open, petals in the wind.

caption: Bazı şeyler görünmeden büyür. Sabret, senin zamanın da gelecek. 🌱🤍
